_what: Frozen evidence for the Rhino example (public Rhino 1.9.1, Fandango 1.3.0 and Grammarinator 26.1 generating fresh, Fuzz4All replaying 100 recorded ClusGram inputs). Frozen after 3 identical fresh runs on 2026-10-08, macOS, -j 4. A difference on another OS is a reproducibility problem to report, not a value to update. first_failing_rank is the position in SpreadEx's priority order (0-based); the budget curve's completion position is not frozen because parallel execution reorders completions.
